title: Figma tokens, responsive grid, and component variants for Console dashboards & cost views
creator: Noah Patel
description: Create a consolidated set of Figma design tokens, a responsive dashboard grid, and component variants specifically tailored for Redwood Console dashboards, rollout controls, and cost breakdown views. Deliverables include token definitions (color, spacing, elevation, type scale), a 12-column responsive grid with presets for metric cards and charts, component variants for card headers/footers, compact/regular table rows, and a small library of micro-interactions in Figma. The goal is to reduce visual inconsistency across Console surfaces and speed up handoff to frontend engineers and the component library team.
acceptance_criteria: Token file exported in Figma and annotated in Confluence (colors, typography, spacing, radii, elevations)
12-column responsive grid with named breakpoints (xs/sm/md/lg/xl) documented and example layouts for Dashboard, Model Rollouts, and Cost Overview pages
Component variants for Metric Card (compact, standard, tall), Chart Card, Table Row (default, hover, selected) and Rollout Toggle with states (on/off/disabled) present in Figma
A single Figma page with a reference kit (tokens + components) and a linkable prototype showcasing dashboard + cost view flows
Design review feedback items resolved or captured as follow-ups with engineers or PMs
